kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ينفقئ (form VII)
# يَنْفَقِئُ (yanfaqiʔu) /jan.fa.qi.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
# يَنْفَقِئَ (yanfaqiʔa) /jan.fa.qi.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
# يَنْفَقِئْ (yanfaqiʔ) /jan.fa.qiʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
